bio: Designed the 24-point and 18-point Vasant faces for the Gujarati Type Foundry's Marathi range, and a Devanagari display face for the Prakash Type Foundry in 1956.

sources.title: Typography of Devanagari, Volume One, pp. 316–318 (Bapurao S. Naik)
sources.publisher: Directorate of Languages, Government of Maharashtra
